headline: Lufthansa Beats Q3 Profit Forecasts But Cuts 2026 Outlook on Fuel Hit
summary: Lufthansa reported third-party profit that beat forecasts but cut its 2026 outlook due to a 600 million euro fuel cost impact.
why: Deutsche Lufthansa is a major European network carrier whose operating margins reflect commercial aviation demand and jet fuel price volatility.

impacts.name: Deutsche Lufthansa AG
impacts.why: Lowering forward outlook and facing substantial fuel headwinds negatively impacts equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A lowered future outlook driven by material fuel cost headwinds outweighed an in-line or beating quarterly profit print, triggering negative revisions.
